input.question: Where is Verona High School located?

documents.text: Verona Area High School Verona Area High School (VAHS) is a high school in Verona, Wisconsin. It is part of the Verona Area School District. Accredited by the North Central Association, VAHS offers a core curriculum in grades 9 through 12 that does not track students by ability; instead advanced opportunities are offered within the curriculum of each course. Consequently, VAHS courses do not carry designations such as "Honors" in their titles.
